- Throughput: low-medium (hundreds of queries/day now, expected to scale to few thousand/day within 6 months)

- Vector DB: currently evaluating Pinecone + Supabase; primary ask: patterns for using Redwood hosted embeddings with external vector stores (do we recommend storing vectors externally or using Redwood-managed vectors?)
